On the way it passes near Rossville, Bayonne, Scenic stretch in Little Falls and in Ridgewood. Long stretches are under trees.

new-york-hudson-valley-rides-litchfield-.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.from: Fuel stop near New Dorp Beach

sections.advice: Treat High point near Rossville → Near Bayonne as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch in Little Falls → Photo stop in Ridgewood is the reward section in New York. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
Photo stop in Ridgewood → Levittown, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Food stop in Freeport → Back to Litchfield Hills is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.
